title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Solid Brass Hardware Bathroom Storage | Venetian Bronze | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized, space-saving storage to your bathroom with this wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and solid brass hardware in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. Designed to coordinate within the Carolina Collection, it complements transitional bathroom hardware and works well with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Thick, beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished installation

- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5.54 Inches

- Product size (overall): 16 Inches (L) x 16 Inches (H) x 5.54 Inches (W)
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
